weapon.d: Grants Spd+3. Unit can counterattack regardless of foe's range. If unit is not adjacent to an ally and unit's Spd > foe's Spd, reduces damage from attacks during combat and from area-of-effect Specials (excluding Røkkr area-of-effect Specials) by percentage = difference between stats × 4 (max 40%).

a.d: If foe initiates combat, grants Spd+2 during combat.
If foe initiates combat, grants Atk/Spd+2 during combat.
If foe initiates combat, grants Atk/Spd+4 during combat.

c.d: At start of turn, inflicts Def-3 on foes within 2 spaces through their next actions.
At start of turn, inflicts Atk/Def-3 on foes within 2 spaces through their next actions.
At start of turn, inflicts Atk/Def-4 on foes within 2 spaces through their next actions.
